findings.finding: Agreement controls over explanatory materials; trading rules incorporated.

Rewards not enforceable entitlement according to text; company can deny/reduce/revoke for any or no reason, determinations final, ordinary review unavailable except discretionary correction or fraud/unlawful conduct.
Associated unpaid rewards can be voided and previous payments offset or invoiced following chargeback/reversal; debt recovery methods listed.
Verification may include live session, video, software/logs and financial records; response within 48h unless extension; noncooperation may terminate and forfeit unpaid rewards.
Graduation at discretion, final reward distribution conditional; invited user can elect authorized cash or voluntarily forfeit part/all for potential allocation, no ownership of live capital.
Exceptional performance or sophisticated/professional methods can trigger termination and unpaid reward denial; company can exempt affiliate program or other approved users.
Dormancy termination may forfeit rewards regardless of prior eligibility; exact current inactivity thresholds need separate rule lookup.
Lifetime safety net equal drawdown limit +$100; $500 minimum withdrawal.
Six payouts maximum then closure and fresh evaluation. Per-request size/sequence caps; for 50K $1,500 first two, $2,000 third, $2,500 fourth/fifth, $3,000 sixth.
Five qualifying days; 50K $250 minimum per day. 50% consistency delays withdrawal, no automatic penalty under owner instruction.
Six payouts and 50% consistency gate; exact size tables distinct from EOD.
